name: XPA, DNA damage recognition and repair factor

function.text: XPA encodes DNA repair protein complementing XP-A cells. Annotated molecular activities include protein homodimerization activity and damaged DNA binding. It participates in DNA repair and UV protection.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to xeroderma pigmentosum group A (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

selection_reason: Panel membership; user authorized the complete proposed and reserve roster.
